title: Soluner's Whacky structures
description: A Datapack created as a first project. This is pretty cool and it adds 3 cool structures with more to come!
body:
# Soluner's Whacky Structures
My first ever datapack puplicly advalable!
Please try it out, I put a lot of work into it.


## Why do you want to download this mod?
You should download it because of the cool ideas and projects that it adds. It will make you wonder just how its all done through a Datapack!

## What is currently added?
There is currently 3 structures added into the game.
The abandoned plains house: A house that has been abandoned for many years. Now for you to find, not so much the loot but the lore it sets.

Abandoned Tiaga Tower: A tower made from the wood and planks of the coldest parts of the minecraft world. It holds some secrets for you to find.

The final structure is for you to find! I'm not going to spill the secrets on anything!


### Items added
(spoliers)
Teleportation sword:
A sword allowing you to teleport 7 blocks in front of you. The items in the gallary are 100% obtanable. So don't worry!


## Future Plans/Ideas

The next idea/fetures that I will be adding is of as follows:

-XP cooldown bar

-Undead wand

-Dungeon Structures

-Bug Fixes and more!


# 

I hope you enjoy this and will download this!

Version 3.6 (alpha)

Created by Soluner
